page_text:
August 23, 2019 

Scott S. Harris, Esq. 
Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

Re:    Ritzen Group Inc. v. Jackson Masonry, LLC, No. 18-938 

Dear Mr. Harris, 

I  am  counsel  for  respondent  Jackson  Masonry,  LLC  (“Respondent”)  in  the  above-
referenced case. On August 5, 2019, petitioner Ritzen Group Inc. (“Petitioner”) filed its merits 
brief.  Pursuant to Rule 25.2, Respondent’s deadline to file a response brief is September 4, 2019.   

Pursuant to Rule 30.4, Respondent respectfully requests a 30-day extension of time to file 
its response brief, which would extend such deadline until October 4, 2019.  Argument in this case 
is scheduled for November 13, 2019.   

Counsel  for  Petitioner  has  consented  to  this  request,  a  copy  of  which  is  being  served 

pursuant to Rule 29.  Thank you for your consideration of this matter.  

Sincerely, 

           /s/ Griffin S. Dunham  
           Griffin S. Dunham 

DUNHAM HILDEBRAND, PLLC 
2416 21st Avenue South, Suite 303 
Nashville, Tennessee 37212 
griffin@dhnashville.com 
Counsel for Respondent 

Cc: Shane G. Ramsey, Counsel of Record for Petitioner 
       Denise McNerney, Merits Cases Clerk, Supreme Court of the United States
